story.title: India's Forex Reserves Fall $14.89 Billion To $766 Billion: RBI Data
story.summary: India's forex reserves dropped by $14.881 billion to $ 765.901 billion during the week ended September 18 due to a fall in foreign currency assets, according to the RBI data.

story.title: Jammu and Kashmir High Court turns down ED plea to insert fresh charges against Farooq Abdullah in JKCA scam
story.summary: The prayer of the petitioner [the ED] seeking addition of charges under Sections 411 and 424 of the Ranbir Penal Code (RPC) does not merit acceptance on the basis of the material presently available and is, accordingly, rejected, held justice Sanjay Parihar, in his order

story.title: BJP wins mayor elections at three municipal corporations in Rajasthan
story.summary: Prasanna Chand Mehta was elected Mayor of Jodhpur, while Anusuiya Goswami was elected to the position in Kota

story.title: Odisha Pedestrian Safety Rules, 2026 proposes pedestrian path mandatory
story.summary: The rules prescribe action against road owning agency, contractor or consultant if a faulty design leads to death or disability or grievous injury of a pedestrians
